text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the City of Toronto capital spending for the six-month period ended June 30, 2025, as well as the projected 2025 year-end expenditures. Furthermore, this report seeks Council's approval for in-year budget adjustments to the previously approved Capital Budget and Plan as outlined in Appendix 2a and Appendix 2b of this report. Table 1 below summarizes the City's 2025 actual capital expenditures compared with the 2025 Approved Capital Budget for the six-month period ended June 30, 2025, and the projected expenditures by year-end, December 31, 2025. City Council on October 8 and 9, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve in-year budget adjustments to Previously Approved Capital Budget and Plan, as detailed in Appendices 2a and 2b to the report (September 15, 2025) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer.
